segments.title: Cold Open & Early Headlines
segments.notes: Pepito delivers station sign-on; Case opens with Jeff Bezos clips, aging commentary, and chat interaction before Hype Train interrupts.

segments.title: Creature Horror Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed for an extended improvised rap about knife-wielding clowns, hatchet bunnies, knife bears, and a multicolored-toothed specter while processing subs and bits.

segments.title: Political & Cultural News Block
segments.notes: Case covers Tulsi Gabbard resignation, Trump on son's wedding, Colbert sign-off, Virginia Foxx vs. 10-year-old EV supporter, Thomas Massey primary loss and AI attack ads, and Hooters rebrand.

segments.title: Nose Itch vs. Butt Itch Debate
segments.notes: Crum argues nasal itching is more embarrassing due to visible picking; Munch counters anal itching signals hygiene failure and designs a curved 'shithorn' scratching implement.

segments.title: Town Hall with Jefferything & Jay Nothing
segments.notes: Call-in segment fields audience questions on senator ménage à trois, Hooters verdict, Twitch partnership, 'slongs' restaurant concept, Time Cop handshake physics, ghost pizzerias, and JD Vance face accusations.

segments.title: Internet Video Review
segments.notes: Case and Kendelle rate chat-submitted clips including Frog King, crab party, Yakuza roof confrontation, and a surreal CGI survival short while bickering about trash bag discipline.

segments.title: Jeff Probst the Fox Interlude
segments.notes: Case portrays an alternate-universe Survivor host who massacred all fox contestants with axes and spears at tribal council, claiming sole survival of season 50.

segments.title: Buck Bumble N64 Playthrough
segments.notes: Brandon battles controller issues, motion sickness, and muffled maternal harassment to complete the 2000 N64 bee shooter, declaring it the most anyone has ever played the game.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Weekend Plans
segments.notes: Kendelle retrieves discarded clothing, confirms Wednesday work schedule, and Case goes casual for a secret weekend party stream tease.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the Friday broadcast, fielded Hype Train's creature-themed freestyle, and oversaw a town hall with surprise guest Jay Nothing.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Delivered the station cold-open sign-on and countdown as executive producer.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical correspondent. Commandeered the feed for an extended freestyle rap about clowns, bunnies, bears, and a multicolored-toothed specter while acknowledging subscriptions.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Munch on the comparative embarrassment of nasal versus anal itching, advocating for the nose with graphic hygiene arguments.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Counters Crum in the itch debate, defending butt-scratching as more discreet and coining the term 'shithorn' for a specialized implement.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: human-interest reporter. Served as town hall co-host alongside Jay Nothing, fielding audience questions on threesomes, Hooters, and ghost pizzerias.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Appeared late in the broadcast to discuss discarded clothing mishaps and upcoming weekend plans with Case.

characters.name: Brandon
characters.notes: gaming correspondent. Struggled through a nauseating Buck Bumble playthrough on N64 while enduring muffled maternal interruptions.

lore_notes.fact: Case considers plastic surgery and 'reblaunding' to regain youthful blonde look.
Case reveals he and Jeff Bezos are the exact same age.
Kendelle reveals Case accidentally threw away her new Unique Glow outfits in a trash bag.
Brandon discloses he has been told he has multiple ulcers.
Brandon's mother jokingly threatens emancipation over his bachelor status.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired a Friday broadcast anchored by Case Blackwell featuring a Hype Train derailment into creature horror freestyle, a Munch & Crum debate on public itching etiquette, and a town hall fielding questions on congressional threesomes and ghost pizzerias. The network's gaming correspondent Brandon endured a physically distressing Buck Bumble session while his mother threatened legal emancipation. Executive producer Pepito opened the hour and Kendelle closed it with a domestic update on discarded wardrobe incidents.
